subject: SCI201
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos covering all specified thermodynamics topics. The selected English videos are from highly-regarded educational channels with strong viewership and direct relevance. The Arabic selections are also strong, drawing from university-level lecture series and popular explainers, though the pool of candidates for some specific topics was smaller. All hard gates were applied and no videos or channels were duplicated within a language.
